answer_1.quote: We generate synthetic bitext by translating the original training samples using MT systems trained on the bitext itself and therefore do not inject any additional supervision in the process.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate translation quality with BLEU on the official development and test splits of the TED corpus.

answer_4.quote: We ask 3 bilingual speakers to evaluate the quality of the EN-EL bitexts. Given an original source sentence, they are asked to rank the original target and the candidate target in the order of their equivalence to the source.
answer_4.guideline: Which sentence conveys the meaning of the source better?
